:::{#exr-augmented-vector-practice}
#### Absorbing an offset into a dot product with the augmented vector

The [augmented vector](#def-augmented-vector) lets software treat an [affine](#def-affine-map) score
as a [dot product](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-dot-product),
with the [offset](#def-affine-offset) as one more [weight](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-weight).
Let $f: \reals^2 \to \reals$ be

$$
f(\vx) = 2 x_1 - x_2 + 5.
$$

Find the vector $\vecf{v} \in \reals^3$ with $f(\vx) = \dprod{\vecf{v}}{\aug{\vx}}$ for every $\vx \in \reals^2$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Follow @exm-augmented-vector.
The first entry of $\aug{\vx}$ is $1$.

:::

:::
